entries.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft with a spine that curls and shoulders that turn. Kneeling facing a high pulley with the rope ends beside the ears; three repetitions in one cycle, as the source orders them: a plain curl down until the elbows reach the knees, then one that turns as it goes down so one elbow travels toward the opposite knee, then the same to the other side, each followed by a slow rise. The hips do not move and the hands stay by the ears throughout. Seen from the side, the turn shows as one shoulder and elbow leading and the other trailing.
entries.summary: Kneeling facing a high pulley with the rope by the ears, curl down until the elbows reach the knees and rise slowly; on the next repetitions turn partway down so one elbow travels to the opposite knee, alternating sides.

frames.caption: Attach a rope to a high pulley, kneel facing it a short step back and hold the rope ends beside the ears.
Keeping the hands by the ears and the hips still, curl the torso down until the elbows reach the knees.
On the next repetition, turn partway down.
One elbow travels to the opposite knee.
Then repeat to the other side.
The other elbow travels to its opposite knee.
Hands stay by the ears. Curl the spine, hips still.
